featured.title: ZOOOX
featured.summary: Cashback and spend analytics that turn everyday purchases into money back and clear insight.
featured.description: ZOOOX is a production-grade cashback and spend-analytics platform. It connects to a user's email, extracts transactions automatically and turns them into interactive dashboards, engineered to stay fast on large datasets and real-time updates, on mobile and web.

featured.title: Buckmint DEX
featured.summary: A decentralised exchange interface with wallet connection, live trading and portfolio tracking.
featured.description: A modern Web3 decentralised exchange: seamless wallet connection, token trading with dynamic token-aware charts, portfolio tracking with live P&L, and full transaction history. Built for real-time crypto trading with a responsive, dark-mode-first interface.

featured.title: Book Transpo
featured.summary: Logistics and ride booking with live tracking, route optimisation and scalable workflows.
featured.description: A logistics and ride-booking platform engineered for real-time operations: live tracking, route optimisation and frictionless booking, with deep mapping integration for accurate navigation and location intelligence, backed by a secure, real-time backend.

featured.title: Umrah Chalo
featured.summary: A deployed travel-booking platform built for seamless UX under real user traffic.
featured.description: A real-world travel platform for discovering and booking Umrah packages. Designed for clarity and responsiveness across devices, with a booking flow built for real traffic, production-ready from day one.

faq.label: 07 · FAQ
faq.sub: The things clients usually ask before the intro call.

items.a: Book a free intro call or send a message with your idea. Within two working days you'll get follow-up questions, a proposed approach and a clear estimate, with no obligation.
Every engagement is scoped upfront: features, milestones and a fixed price before we write code. You approve the number first. No hourly surprises, no hidden fees.

items.q: Who will actually work on my project?
items.a: The engineers you meet in the intro call are the ones who build your product. You have direct access to them the whole way, with no account managers in between.
Yes. Full ownership of the codebase, designs and documentation at every milestone, plus a handover session so your team is never locked in.
Every build ships with a bug-fix window. After that, ongoing support, maintenance and growth engineering (ASO, performance, new features) are available as a retainer.
